quantification: TMT reporter ion intensities were quantified using a 0.003 Da window around the theoretical m/z for each reporter ion in the MS3 scan

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study focuses on identifying DUB substrates by measuring changes in total protein abundance following inhibitor treatment. While the biological context is ubiquitination, the proteomics assay itself is a global proteome analysis (TMT-labeled bottom-up DDA) and does not employ PTM-specific enrichment (e.g., no diGly or QQTGG antibodies used for the MS runs described in the methods).

organism: MS/MS spectra were searched against a Uniprot Homo sapiens database
cell_lines: MM.1S cells were purchased from ATCC
scope: Cell pellets were lysed by resuspending in lysis buffer
Protein concentration of the cell lysate was determined by micro-BCA assay
to achieve a cell lysate with a protein concentration between 1 - 4 mg/mL

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The experiment used whole cell lysates from MM.1S myeloma cells to identify DUB substrates via TMT-based quantitative proteomics.
